message: An assistant finds a free hour and proposes a focus session. The person declines, so the calendar remains unchanged.
audience: People interested in practical AI assistance, explained in plain language
claims: Illustrates an assistant finding an open calendar hour and proposing a focus session.
Illustrates a person declining the proposal, after which the original calendar remains unchanged.
illustrative_assumptions: The existing 3 PM appointment is labeled TEAM.
The open hour begins at 4 PM, and the proposed session is labeled FOCUS.
The assistant and person are staged beside a calendar board.
ending_action: Hold on the unchanged calendar with the original 3 PM TEAM appointment and an empty 4 PM hour.

beats.subject: Assistant and calendar
beats.action: The assistant points to the empty 4 PM hour.
beats.before_after: Before: the board shows TEAM at 3 PM and an empty 4 PM slot. After: the assistant visibly indicates the open hour.
beats.focal_detail: The empty 4 PM row beside the pointing assistant.
beats.consequence: The available hour is clearly identified.
beats.narration: Assistant spots an open hour at four.
beats.caption: Finding a free hour
beats.headline: OPEN HOUR

beats.subject: Calendar proposal
beats.action: A dashed FOCUS card appears in the empty 4 PM slot.
beats.before_after: Before: 4 PM is empty. After: a dashed FOCUS proposal occupies the slot.
beats.focal_detail: The dashed border distinguishing the proposal from the solid TEAM appointment.
beats.consequence: The focus session is visible but not booked.
beats.narration: It proposes focus time, placing a dashed card there.
beats.caption: Proposing focus time
beats.headline: PROPOSED

beats.subject: Person and proposal
beats.action: A person's finger presses DECLINE; a cross registers and the dashed FOCUS card disappears.
beats.before_after: Before: the dashed FOCUS proposal is visible at 4 PM. After: the proposal is removed while TEAM remains solid at 3 PM.
beats.focal_detail: The fingertip on DECLINE, followed by the cross and removal.
beats.consequence: The proposed focus session is rejected without changing the existing appointment.
beats.narration: The person presses decline, removing the proposal while the existing meeting stays.
beats.caption: Your decision

beats.subject: Calendar
beats.action: The board visibly holds on the original schedule.
beats.before_after: Before: the declined proposal has been removed. After: TEAM remains at 3 PM and 4 PM is empty.
beats.focal_detail: The solid TEAM card and clean, empty 4 PM row.
beats.consequence: The ending confirms that nothing was added or moved.
beats.narration: The original calendar remains visibly unchanged.
beats.caption: Original schedule
beats.headline: CALENDAR UNCHANGED
